name: Priya Sharma
bio:
Priya's fascination with motorsport began during her university days, captivated by the intricate engineering behind Formula 1 cars. After graduating with a degree in Mechanical Engineering from IIT Delhi, she pursued a career focused on simulation technology. Her journey started with an internship at a leading automotive research facility, where she honed her skills in data analysis and virtual testing. This experience ignited her passion for applying simulation to enhance driver performance and vehicle dynamics.

Priya joined Full Time Sports three years ago, quickly establishing herself as a valuable asset. Her approach to simulator engineering is methodical and data-driven, constantly seeking ways to refine the simulation environment to better reflect real-world conditions. She believes in fostering a collaborative environment, working closely with drivers and race engineers to identify areas for improvement and develop innovative solutions. Her dedication to pushing the boundaries of simulation technology makes her a distinctive member of the team.

Priya's innovative approach has led to several breakthroughs in simulator fidelity. Her recent work in improving the tire model simulation has been crucial in the team's success.
